title: The Perfect Cipher
author: J. M. Iversen
blurb: Tamsin Zhou, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
